LESSON: LEVERS AS SIMPLE MACHINES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.2: Levers as simple machines

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Levers as simple machines. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How are levers used in day to day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify common levers used in day- to-day life
2. describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier
3. classify levers into the three classes

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify common levers used in day- to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can identify common levers used in day- to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier
   In simple words: practise until you can describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. classify levers into the three classes
   In simple words: practise until you can classify levers into the three classes. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Levers as simple machines using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Levers as simple machines in the examples.
2. Explain Levers as simple machines to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Levers as simple machines.
4. Show that you can: identify common levers used in day- to-day life

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Levers as simple machines using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Levers as simple machines important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Creativity and imagination: The learner assembles different parts and innovatively makes a beam balance from locally available materials.
2. Agriculture and Nutrition: Learner is able to link application of the principle of levers in farm tools, use of cutlery; spoons and bottle openers as in Agriculture and Nutrition.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify common levers used in day- to-day life
2. describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier
3. classify levers into the three classes

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
